title: 第二十一章一棍之威砸成肉泥第二十二章毕长老出手
content_zh:
面对宛如烈日般的火焰巨球，苏阳没有丝毫畏惧之意。
三年，这一棍里面包含了太多的情绪，也蕴含了苏阳体内能够释放的所有力量！
沸腾的至尊之血，环绕的三玄之气，以及滔天涌动的斗战圣法。
与王家所有的恩怨，都在这一棍之中。
苏阳岂能畏惧？又何须畏惧！！！
当虚空中那一道棍影，结结实实砸在了火球之上时，巨大的撞击之力，让苏阳整个身躯都被火焰巨球所吞噬进去。
见此一幕，王依依终于狂笑道：“哈哈哈，苏阳，你也太自大了。妄想与本小姐抗衡？你以为本小姐是爱你么？你早以不是当年的苏阳，你只不过是本小姐圈养了三年的血奴罢了。你这个废物！早就该去见阎王了。”
此刻，还在和王朗交战的李北叶，也看见了苏阳被王依依的巨大火球所吞噬，不由瞪大瞳孔，慌了心神。
王朗何等人也？岂会放过李北叶分心的机会。
只见他接连拍出数掌，罡风之力以极快的速度轰向李北叶而去。
李北叶这才缓过神，见已经无法躲闪，只能强行将长枪立于身前，想借助长枪之力挡住王朗的攻击。
轰轰轰！
劲爆的罡风全部击中了李北叶的那把长枪之上。
强大的力量将后者瞬间轰飞百米，由于王朗用尽了全部力量，即便是李北叶此刻也不由受了内伤。
倒退的身躯洞穿了不少房屋后，才逐渐停了下来。
“该死！大意了。”李北叶半跪在地，左手捂着胸口，右手紧握长枪，嘴角流出一丝鲜血，目光极度可怕道。
“哈哈哈！李城主，别这么在意一位无名小辈，马上我便送你下去。”王朗偷袭成功，此刻无比的意气风发道。
可李北叶却丝毫没在意自己身上的伤势，而是微微抬起头，看着久久未散的巨大火球，目光之中无比复杂，心中暗自祈祷着：“苏阳....千万不要有事啊。”
“妈..妈妈..我怕！！”这时一道小孩的哭泣之声，引起了李北叶的注意。
他这才发现，自己刚才被王朗轰进了百姓居住的房间之中。

此刻，刚好有一对母子在不远处抱着彼此，瑟瑟发抖。
这让李北叶不由又想起了他的女儿，刚欲起身离去，便见一把长剑化为无数剑影朝他袭来。
“李北叶，老夫这就送你一程！”
“灵剑之法，万剑随行！”
这是王朗的必杀绝学，也是他从来没有施展过的一门功法，更是他的唯一底牌。
王朗见李北叶再度分心，自然不会手下留情，毫无顾忌的施展出了他的必杀绝学，在他看来，李北叶这次无论如何也来不及躲闪了。
此时的李北叶，瞳孔之中只有无数朝他袭来的剑影，他想要躲闪，却发现自己已经无法动弹了。
只能眼睁睁看着自己的死亡来临。
就在李北叶已经要放弃闭上眼的时候，一道熟悉的声音突然响起道：“休要伤我父亲！！！”
紧接着，一股寒意到极致的可怕阴气，弥漫在整个房间。
叶北城内，隐匿在各处的势力和散修，看见苏阳被王依依的巨大火球所吞噬后，都觉得这场战斗已经结束了。
最终，还是王依依更胜一筹，而曾经的天才少年苏阳，则是复仇失败。
“哎，可惜了。这王依依太过凶猛，体内又有两种血脉之力，苏阳即便再天才，毕竟浪费了三年时光，如今能够将王依依逼到这种地步，已经不错了。”
“是啊，看来还是王府笑到了最后。”
content_en:
Facing the giant flaming ball that looked like the scorching sun, Su Yang showed no fear at all.
In three years, this stick contains too many emotions, and also contains all the power that Su Yang can release in his body!
The boiling blood of the Supreme, the surrounding Qi of the Three Mysteries, and the surging Holy Law of Fighting.
All the grievances with the Wang family are contained in this stick.
How could Su Yang be afraid? Why be afraid! ! !
When the stick shadow in the void hit the fire ball firmly, the huge force of the impact caused Su Yang's entire body to be swallowed up by the giant flame ball.
Seeing this scene, Wang Yiyi finally laughed wildly and said: "Hahaha, Su Yang, you are too arrogant. Do you want to compete with me? Do you think I love you? You have long thought that you are not the Su Yang you were back then. You are just a blood slave that I have kept in captivity for three years. You loser! You should have gone to see the King of Hell a long time ago."
At this moment, Li Beiye, who was still fighting with Wang Lang, also saw Su Yang being swallowed by Wang Yiyi's huge fireball. His pupils widened and he panicked.
Who is Wang Lang? How could he let Li Beiye get distracted?
I saw him slap several palms in succession, and the power of the strong wind blasted towards Li Beiye at an extremely fast speed.
Li Beiye finally regained his composure. Seeing that he could no longer dodge, he could only forcefully stand the spear in front of him, hoping to use the power of the spear to block Wang Lang's attack.
Boom boom boom!
The powerful wind hit Li Beiye's spear.
The powerful force blasted the latter a hundred meters away in an instant. Because Wang Lang used all his strength, even Li Beiye could not help but suffer internal injuries at this moment.
The retreating body penetrated many houses before gradually stopping.
"Damn it! You were careless." Li Beiye half-knelt on the ground, covering his chest with his left hand and holding the spear tightly with his right hand. A trace of blood flowed from the corner of his mouth, and his eyes were extremely scary.
"Hahaha! City Lord Li, don't care so much about an unknown young man. I will send you down immediately." Wang Lang succeeded in the sneak attack, and he was extremely high-spirited at this moment.
But Li Beiye didn't care about his injuries at all. Instead, he raised his head slightly and looked at the huge fireball that had not dispersed for a long time. His eyes were extremely complicated and he secretly prayed in his heart: "Su Yang...don't let anything happen."
"Mom...Mom...I'm scared!!" At this time, the cry of a child caught Li Beiye's attention.
Only then did he realize that he had just been blasted into the room where the people lived by Wang Lang.
At this moment, there happened to be a mother and son hugging each other not far away, shivering.
This made Li Beiye think of his daughter again. Just as he was about to get up and leave, he saw a long sword turning into countless sword shadows and attacking him.
"Li Beiye, I will give you a ride right now!"
"The method of the spiritual sword is accompanied by thousands of swords!"
This is Wang Lang's ultimate skill, a technique he has never used before, and it is his only trump card.
Seeing that Li Beiye was distracted again, Wang Lang naturally showed no mercy and used his ultimate skill without any scruples. In his opinion, Li Beiye would have no time to dodge this time.
At this time, Li Beiye's pupils only saw countless sword shadows attacking him. He wanted to dodge, but found that he could no longer move.
I can only watch my own death coming.
Just when Li Beiye was about to give up and close his eyes, a familiar voice suddenly sounded: "Don't hurt my father!!!"
Immediately afterwards, a terrifying and extremely chilly air filled the entire room.
In Yebei City, the hidden forces and casual cultivators felt that the battle was over after seeing Su Yang being swallowed by Wang Yiyi's huge fireball.
In the end, Wang Yiyi was the better, but Su Yang, the former genius boy, failed in his revenge.
"Hey, it's a pity. This Wang Yiyi is too ferocious, and he has the power of two bloodlines in his body. No matter how talented Su Yang is, he has wasted three years, and now he can force Wang Yiyi to this point.Not bad. "
"Yes, it seems that the palace has the last laugh. "
